subject: Interconnection milestones
body: Can you confirm the DD memo will cover the milestone dates and security posting requirements in the ERCOT interconnection agreement? Credit asked about it this morning.

label.note: Interconnection agreement is named in the DD scope.

subject: Hedge documents
body: The hedge provider has sent over their draft ISDA schedule and a confirmation. Could you take a look and let us know if anything stands out?

subject: DSCR lock-up
body: Borrower's counsel is pushing back on the 1.10x lock-up and wants an equity cure. Please mark up their comments on the credit agreement and send us a short note on the position.

label.note: Financial covenants sit in the credit agreement workstream.

subject: Borrower resolutions
body: To save time, could you prepare the borrower's written consent and officer's certificate approving the financing? Their counsel is slow.

label.note: Borrower-side documents are excluded (and a conflict point).

subject: Substation parcels
body: The sponsor has added two parcels for the substation that weren't in the original site plan. Can you extend the due diligence to cover them?

label.note: DD covers the project site as defined in the term sheet; new parcels extend it. Scope change to discuss.

subject: Pledge agreement
body: Please send us the latest draft pledge agreement so we can share it with the collateral agent.

label.note: Pledge is in the collateral workstream.

subject: Tax credit transfer
body: Quick one: will the sponsor's planned sale of the production tax credits under section 6418 work, and what is the buyer's recapture risk?

label.note: Tax advice and tax credit transfers are excluded.

subject: Mezzanine lender
body: The sponsor wants to bring in a mezzanine lender later in construction. Could you draft a short intercreditor term sheet so we can react?

subject: Closing checklist
body: Could you send the closing checklist with current status ahead of Monday's call?

label.note: Closing checklist is in the CP workstream.

subject: Sponsor call
body: Can you join the sponsor call on Thursday and walk them through how the collateral structure works?

label.note: Negotiating collateral is in scope, but explaining it to the sponsor is advice to the other side. Partner to decide.

subject: ESG covenant
body: Please add the ESG reporting covenant we agreed internally to the next turn of the credit agreement.

label.note: ESG covenants are in the credit agreement workstream.

subject: Contractor delay
body: The balance-of-plant contractor is threatening to claim delay damages against the borrower. What are our options as lenders if this escalates?

subject: Turbine warranties
body: Does the DD memo cover the warranty package in the turbine supply agreement? Our independent engineer flagged it.

label.note: Turbine supply agreement is a named material contract.

subject: Deed of trust memo
body: Our credit committee would like a short memo on how long foreclosure under a Texas deed of trust would take compared with a judicial foreclosure.

label.note: The deed of trust is in scope, but an enforcement memo for credit committee is new work. Agree with client first.

subject: Refinancing
body: Assuming we close in December, could you start thinking about the structure for a refinancing in 2029?

subject: Legal opinion
body: Please prepare the draft enforceability opinion for the first funding.

label.note: Legal opinion is in the CP workstream.
